scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Hey, there!
It's 10,000 Zeny to go to Port Malaya. Interested?
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
嘿，你好！
去马来港需要10,000 Zeny。有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: About Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 关于马来港

scripts.text: Go to Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 前往马来港

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Port Malaya is a small village you could reach by sailing southwest from Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
马来港是一个小村庄，从艾尔贝塔向西南方向航行即可到达。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I couldn't visit the village because they had some issues there but now it seems all is clear!
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
之前因为村里有些问题，我没法去拜访，但现在看来一切都已经解决了！

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I don't know for sure but it was a village that's like a comfortable and cozy park.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
我不太确定，但那里就像是一个舒适又温馨的公园。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I was this close to not coming back to cozy Alberta again.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
我差点就不想回温馨的艾尔贝塔了。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I'm sure you'll feel the same once you reach Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
我相信你到了马来港后，也会有一样的感受。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Oh God!!
You don't know how far it is from here. Of course it's not free. Please come back with 10,000 Zeny. Sorry!
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
天哪！！
你知道那里离这儿有多远吗？当然不是免费的。请带着10,000 Zeny再来吧。抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Great!
Heading for Port Malaya!!
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
太好了！
前往马来港！！

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Adventurers these days act like they are busy. Come back when you have the time and we could go visit Port Malaya together.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
现在的冒险者好像都很忙。等你有空的时候回来，我们可以一起去马来港看看。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I think the village is still busy. Done with your visit? There is always a ship heading for Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
村里好像还是挺乱的。参观完了吗？随时都有开往艾尔贝塔的船。

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
I think a nameless adventurer helped take a load off the villagers' minds. Yahoo! Would you like to go back to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
好像是一位无名的冒险者帮村民们解除了心头大患。太好了！你要回艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Would you like to go back to Alberta with me?
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
你想和我一起回艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Return.
scripts.translation: 返回

scripts.text: Do not return.
scripts.translation: 不返回

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
Great! Let's leave now for Alberta!!
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
太好了！我们现在就出发去艾尔贝塔！！

scripts.text:
[Optamara Crew]
That's okay. Come here if you ever want to go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[奥普塔玛拉船员]
没关系。如果你以后想回艾尔贝塔，随时来这里。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Oh my! Visiting?
What bad timing. The village is a bit unorganized at the moment so I'm actually closed. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哎呀！是来参观的吗？
真不巧。村里现在有点乱，所以我暂时歇业了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
So you are the adventurer villagers are talking about? I reopened my inn thanks to you. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
原来你就是村民们说的那位冒险者？多亏了你，我的旅店重新开张了。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Welcome.
This is Port Malaya's best inn, 'Cabin in the City'.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
欢迎光临。
这里是马来港最好的旅店——“城市小屋”。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Come for a rest? Lodging will be 5,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
来休息吗？住宿费是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Store.
scripts.translation: 存档

scripts.text: Lodge. - 5,000z
Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Successfully stored. See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
存档成功。下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Sorry. I think you are a bit short.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
抱歉。您的钱好像不太够。

scripts.text:
[Inn Keeper]
Hope you enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
祝您住得愉快。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you, blushes and then disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，脸红了一下，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you and disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature looks at you and runs away.
scripts.translation: 不明生物看着你，然后跑开了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you, blushes and then disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，脸红了一下，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you and disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature looks at you and runs away.
scripts.translation: 不明生物看着你，然后跑开了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You're not from around here? Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你不是本地人吧？请照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I'm worried because my daughter-in-law is pregnant. I hope nothing goes wrong.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我儿媳妇怀孕了，我很担心。希望一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I heard there is an outsider that is helping the village.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
听说有个外乡人在帮村子的忙。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Then my daughter-in-law will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那样我儿媳妇就安全了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Heard there is this {0} that follows Meoneonuncle around.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
听说有个叫{0}的人一直跟在玛那能革后面。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I will cheer for their forbidden love.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我会为他们的禁忌之恋加油的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I'm worried about my pregnant daughter-in-law. Hope Meoneonuncle won't bother her.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我很担心怀孕的儿媳妇。希望玛那能革不要去找她。

scripts.text: Meoneonuncle?
scripts.translation: 玛那能革？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Not from around here? Let me tell you why even a foreigner like you should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你不是本地人吧？我来告诉你，为什么连你这样的外乡人也要小心。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Meoneonuncle was a woman who lived in Port Malaya long ago. She married a decent man and also had a baby.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
玛那能革原本是很久以前住在马来港的一名女子。她嫁给了一个好男人，还怀了孩子。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
But happiness never lasts forever, right? The baby was miscarried from an accident...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
但幸福总是不能长久，对吧？她因为一场意外流产了...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
She eventually passed away after grieving over her lost baby for days.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
她为失去的孩子悲痛了好几天，最后也离开了人世。

scripts.text: That is a sad story.
scripts.translation: 真是个悲伤的故事

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Meoneonuncle then started to appear in spirit and take away babies from pregnant women in the village.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
后来玛那能革就化作怨灵出现，开始夺走村里孕妇腹中的胎儿。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
If you ever walk around Port Malaya at night...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
如果你夜里在马来港走动...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
And hear either tik-tik or wak-wak, be cautious because that is the sound of Meoneonuncle's wings flapping.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
听到“滴克滴克”或“哇克哇克”的声音，就要小心了，那是玛那能革拍打翅膀的声音。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Ugh... it's just like that time before...
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
唉...就像之前那次一样...

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
When the moon was swallowed. Argh!
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
就是月亮被吞掉的那次。啊！

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
I think the village was saved by a nameless adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
听说村子是被一位无名的冒险者拯救的。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Phew... I thought Bakonawa appeared again.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
呼...我还以为巴库暴龙又出现了。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
{0} is said to have stopped Bakonawa from swallowing the moon. Isn't it awesome? I'm so relieved.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
据说{0}阻止了巴库暴龙吞下月亮。是不是很厉害？我总算放心了。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Bakonawa is also known as the 'monster that swallows the moon' in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
在马来港，巴库暴龙也被称为“吞月的魔物”。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
But I know that Bakonawa could also 'swallow people', too.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
但我知道，巴库暴龙也会“吞人”。

scripts.text: Huk! Then isn't it dangerous?
scripts.translation: 呃！那不是很危险吗？

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Ha ha ha. There is a way to stop Bakonawa from swallowing a person.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
哈哈哈。有办法不让巴库暴龙吞人。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Yes, there is a weakness to even the worst monster that swallowed 6 moons already.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
没错，就算是已经吞过6个月亮的凶恶魔物，也有弱点。

scripts.text: Wow. What is it?
scripts.translation: 哇。是什么？

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
He is sensitive to noise so when he's about to swallow the moon!!
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
它怕吵，所以当它要吞月亮的时候！！

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
That's your chance!! It doesn't matter what kind of noise!! Whether it's a caldron, symbol, drum, pot or fry pan, just keep on making noise.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
就是你的机会！！什么声音都行！！大锅、铙钹、鼓、罐子还是平底锅都好，只管不停地制造噪音。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Then Bakonawa will get surprised, spit out the moon and run away!
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
巴库暴龙就会吓一跳，吐出月亮逃走！

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Carry a drum around with you. You'll find it handy.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
随身带一面鼓吧。会派上用场的。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
The village is chaotic these days. Is it okay for me to be off like this?
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
最近村里很乱。我这样偷懒真的没问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
The village is somewhat stable now but you should still be careful walking around at night.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
村里现在稍微安定了一些，但你晚上出门还是要小心。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
{0} is said to escape from Buwaya alive after being captured. This person must be powerful.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
听说{0}被宝箱巨鳄抓住后还活着逃了出来。这个人一定很厉害。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
What!! Port all clear!!
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
是！！港口一切正常！！

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
Huh? You're not the captain? You scared me. Shoot! Ah, right! I received an official document for travelers.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
嗯？你不是队长啊？吓死我了。真是的！啊，对了！我收到了一份给旅行者的公文。

scripts.text: What document?
scripts.translation: 什么文件？

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
It says that travelers should be careful of monsters when walking in the village at night.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
上面说旅行者晚上在村里行走时要小心魔物。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
Buwaya don't come to the village often but there are cases when they snatch people in the boxes they carry at night.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
宝箱巨鳄不常来村里，但也有过它们夜里用背着的箱子把人掳走的事。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
Huh?! And it says here that a monster named Wokwok especially visits the village often at night and should be avoided.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
咦？！这上面还写着，有一种叫沃沃克的魔物经常在夜里来村里，一定要避开。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 原来如此

scripts.text: Is there any way to prevent them from coming?
scripts.translation: 有什么办法能阻止它们来吗？

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
Be careful at night!
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
晚上要小心！

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
They say you can attack Buwaya's weak point inside the box they carry if you ever get caught in one.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
据说万一被宝箱巨鳄抓进箱子里，可以攻击它藏在箱子里的弱点。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
And you should run into the nearest building when you hear Wokwoks wings fluttering from afar.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
要是听到远处传来沃沃克扑扇翅膀的声音，就赶快跑进最近的建筑物里。

scripts.text:
[Port Guard]
But if the fluttering sound is small or if you don't hear anything, let's just say you should prepare for attack and wish for luck.
scripts.translation:
[港口卫兵]
但如果扑扇声很小，或者什么都没听到，那只能说你要做好被袭击的准备，祈祷好运了。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
I'm scared but I have to visit the fairy in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
我很害怕，但我一定要去森林里找妖精。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
He he. Father said I can visit the fairy in the forest when the village calms down.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
嘿嘿。爸爸说等村里平静下来，我就可以去森林里找妖精了。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
A little while ago {0} came and told me a fun story.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
刚才{0}过来给我讲了一个有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
'I planted a pair of pear trees in the yard.'
He he. Isn't it fun? {0} seems like a fun person.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
“我在院子里种了一对梨树。”
嘿嘿。很有趣吧？{0}好像是个很有意思的人。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
Father said I won't catch skin diseases once I'm friends with the fairy from the forest.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
爸爸说，只要和森林里的妖精交上朋友，就不会得皮肤病了。

scripts.text: What is this fairy?
scripts.translation: 那是什么妖精？

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
Encan'to! Encan'to fairies live in big trees or rocks in the forest. There are boy fairies and girl fairies...
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
昂坎图！昂坎图妖精住在森林里的大树或岩石里。有男孩妖精，也有女孩妖精...

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
But boy fairies are prettier. Why is that?
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
不过男孩妖精更漂亮。为什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
My mom told me not to play outside because its dangerous. Why?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
妈妈说外面很危险，不让我出去玩。为什么呀？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
My mom told me I can play but only in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
妈妈说我可以出去玩，但只能在马来港里面。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
He he. But I never thought of going outside of Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
嘿嘿。但我从来没想过要去马来港以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
I heard someone took Jejelings hat in Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
我听说有人在巴里奥·马希瓦加抢了食人波利的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Why would someone steal a monster's hat? {0} must be desperate.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
为什么会有人去偷魔物的帽子？{0}一定是走投无路了。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Oh wait! This was suppose to be a secret. Shsh! Please pretend you didn't hear me.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
啊，等等！这本来是秘密。嘘！请假装没听到。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
I think someone is stealing all the hats in the village.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
我觉得有人在偷村里所有的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
The hat my mom washed yesterday disappeared. Our neighbor's hat also disappeared a few days ago.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
妈妈昨天洗的帽子不见了。邻居的帽子前几天也不见了。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Hmm... do you think Jejeling took it?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
嗯...你觉得是食人波利拿的吗？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
I visited a friend in Baryo Mahiwaga and he said he saw Jejeling wearing the missing hat...
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
我去巴里奥·马希瓦加找朋友玩，他说看到食人波利戴着那顶不见的帽子...

scripts.text:
[Local]
Hmm... is it time to be careful of the witches' curse?
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
嗯...是时候小心女巫的诅咒了吗？

scripts.text:
[Local]
Beware of Mongkukurums needle, foreigner.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
小心蒙库库鲁姆的针，外乡人。

scripts.text:
[Local]
Welcome to Port Malaya, foreigner..
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
欢迎来到马来港，外乡人..

scripts.text:
[Local]
The village is chaotic these days. If you see someone with red eyes, try not to stare at their eyes.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
最近村里很乱。如果看到有人长着红眼睛，尽量别盯着他的眼睛看。

scripts.text:
[Local]
Be careful walking around the village at night. {0} was taken down by Wokwok.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
晚上在村里走动要小心。{0}就被沃沃克打倒了。

scripts.text:
[Local]
{0} is said to have successfully tamed a Tikbalang. This person must be courageous. Wonder if I'll get to see this tamed Tikbalang?
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
据说{0}成功驯服了一匹邪魔马。这个人一定很勇敢。不知道我有没有机会见见那匹被驯服的邪魔马？

scripts.text:
[Local]
Have you ever seen Bongisungisu? I heard {0} is hunting down Bongisungisus.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
你见过邦吉松吉苏吗？我听说{0}正在猎杀邦吉松吉苏。

scripts.text:
[Local]
If you plan to go out of the village, be careful of Tiucknuc. {0} is said to be tricked by Tiucknuc and had to go to the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
如果你打算出村，要小心恶魔婴儿。据说{0}被恶魔婴儿骗了，结果进了医院。

scripts.text:
[Local]
The village is chaotic these days. Looks like Mongkukurum is back in the village.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
最近村里很乱。看来蒙库库鲁姆又回到村里了。

scripts.text: Mongkukurum?
scripts.translation: 蒙库库鲁姆？

scripts.text:
[Local]
A monster that is also called witch. Looks like a person and also wears clothes.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
一种也被称为女巫的魔物。长得像人，还会穿衣服。

scripts.text:
[Local]
Mongkukurum makes a doll out of the people it sees and curses it with needles.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
蒙库库鲁姆会照着它见到的人做成人偶，再用针来诅咒。

scripts.text: Is there a way to recognize this monster?
scripts.translation: 有什么办法能认出这种魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Local]
There is one way. All Mongkukurum have red eyes.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
有一个办法。蒙库库鲁姆都长着红眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Local]
You can recognize them by their eyes but! You must remember one thing.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
你可以通过眼睛认出它们，但是！你必须记住一件事。

scripts.text:
[Local]
You will be captivated by Mongkukurum if you stare at their eyes too long.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
如果盯着蒙库库鲁姆的眼睛看太久，就会被它迷惑。

scripts.text:
[Local]
Never ever stare into their eyes for too long.
scripts.translation:
[当地人]
千万不要盯着它们的眼睛看太久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Foreigners are not welcomed that much when our village is chaotic like these days.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我们村子这么乱的时候，外乡人可不太受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You are out of luck visiting the village at a time like this and not being welcomed.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你运气真差，偏偏在这种时候来，还不受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
{0} is said to throw out Jellopy in this village.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
据说{0}在这个村子里乱扔杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Tsk, tsk... Must be a person that isn't worthy of a Jellopy.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
啧啧...肯定是个连杰勒比结晶都配不上的人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You must also look out to see if Bangungot lives in a tree you are about to cut down.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你要砍树之前，也要留意那棵树上有没有住着噩梦死神般滚勾特。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Because strange things happen if logs from trees that Bangungot lived in are used as building pillars.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
因为如果用噩梦死神般滚勾特住过的树来做房子的柱子，就会发生怪事。

scripts.text: What happens?
scripts.translation: 会发生什么？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, for a Bangungot, it means losing its home so they get vengeful.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，对噩梦死神般滚勾特来说，这就等于失去了家，所以它们会怀恨报复。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
When you try to sleep near the pillar, it will keep awake by playing pranks at first.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你在柱子旁边睡觉时，它们一开始会搞恶作剧让你睡不着。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
But as time goes by and their vengeance grows, they sit on top of you until you suffocate.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
但随着时间推移，它们的怨恨越来越深，就会坐在你身上，直到你窒息为止。

scripts.text: Oh, gosh...
scripts.translation: 哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ha ha ha. There are no Bangungots in normal pillars, so don't lose sleep over it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哈哈哈。普通的柱子里可没有噩梦死神般滚勾特，所以别为这个睡不着觉。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
I don't have anything to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
我没什么可以跟你说的。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Im worried about the children. I hope they aren't terrified from whats going on in the village.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
我很担心孩子们。希望村里发生的事别把他们吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
I like fun stories. Not so long ago, {0} came and told me a funny story.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
我喜欢好玩的故事。不久前，{0}来给我讲了个笑话。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
'My aunt stepped on an ant.'
scripts.translation:
[女子]
“我阿姨踩到了一只蚂蚁。”

scripts.text:
[Woman]
'You eat chili on a chilly day.'
scripts.translation:
[女子]
“在寒冷的日子里吃辣椒。”

scripts.text:
[Woman]
'Why are you putting flour on that flower?'
scripts.translation:
[女子]
“你为什么在那朵花上撒面粉？”

scripts.text:
[Woman]
At the Tool Store, 'Ill buy the needle and thread! You buy the hay to lose the needle in.'
scripts.translation:
[女子]
在工具店说：“我买针和线！你去买干草来让我把针藏进去。”

scripts.text:
[Woman]
{0} said that and was kicked out of the Tool Store.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
{0}说完这话，就被赶出了工具店。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
A Kafra Employee I'm friends with told me a story about a customer.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
跟我要好的一位卡普拉职员给我讲了一个顾客的故事。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
'Kafra, the wise never marry and when they marry, they become otherwise.'
scripts.translation:
[女子]
“卡普拉，智者从不结婚，一旦结婚，就不再是智者了。”

scripts.text:
[Woman]
He he... I do like funny stories but a bit difficult for my taste.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
呵呵...我是喜欢笑话，不过这个对我来说有点难懂。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
I like fun stories. Oh by the way! {0}, love is photogenic. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[女子]
我喜欢好玩的故事。对了！{0}，爱情就像照片，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Woman]
It needs darkness to develop.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
都需要在黑暗中才能显影。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
He he. Isn't it fun?
scripts.translation:
[女子]
呵呵。是不是很有趣？

scripts.text:
[Woman]
If you hear a baby crying from the forest outside of the village, never go near it.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
如果听到村外的森林里传来婴儿的哭声，千万不要靠近。

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text:
[Woman]
There is a monster named Tiucknuc that roams around outside of the village and cries after transforming himself into a baby.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
村外有一种叫恶魔婴儿的魔物到处游荡，它会变成婴儿的样子哭泣。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
But when kind travelers pick up the baby, it turns back into its original form and attacks.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
但当善良的旅行者抱起那个婴儿时，它就会变回原形并发起攻击。

scripts.text: Sounds like a sneaky monster.
scripts.translation: 听起来是只狡猾的魔物

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Yes, this monster is bad to trick the kindness of travelers but...
scripts.translation:
[女子]
是啊，这种魔物利用旅行者的善心，确实可恶，但是...

scripts.text:
[Woman]
There is rumor that the monster came from the soul of a baby that never been born. So sad.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
有传言说，这种魔物是由未能出生的婴儿的灵魂变成的。真是可怜。

Oh! Other Jeepneys are in operation, of course.
scripts.translation:
[吉普尼司机]

scripts.text:
[Jeepney Driver]
In Port Malaya there are 12, 30 and 60 passenger Jeepneys with 3 each operating.
scripts.translation:
[吉普尼司机]
马来港有12人座、30人座和60人座的吉普尼车，各有3辆在运营。

scripts.text:
[Jeepney Driver]
Would you like to know the location of other cars?
scripts.translation:

您想知道其他车辆的位置吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to know where the 12 passenger car is.

Have a nice trip.
